asked.item: how long comments and DMs are kept in Inbox
whether older Instagram DMs from before connecting are imported

verdict.reason: S14 states the retention period and S12/S13 state that older Instagram DMs are not imported.

steps.text: Comments and messages are retained for up to 45 days.
Blotato does not import older Instagram posts, comments, or direct messages.
It starts capturing new comments and messages after your account connects with the required permissions.
